title: A JSON Schema inclusion benchmark case
description: What is known about the two schemas next to this file: does a.json accept every instance valid under b.json? The labels hold for draft 2020-12 with format asserted and patterns read in the dialect of the Rust regex crate.

a_subsumes_b.description: Whether a.json accepts every instance valid under b.json; null when the corpus claims nothing.

b_subsumes_a.description: The same question in the other direction.

features.description: What the two schemas use, in the order of this list: every keyword that validation can reach and that decides what a schema accepts, 'recursion' when a schema is reached again from itself through a reference, and 'metaschema' when a reference leads to a meta-schema of the draft, whose own keywords are not listed.

upstream.description: The file this case comes from, as a path inside the source repository that collection.json names; the test suite's cases add a JSON pointer to the test case or the test after a '#'.

note.description: Why the labels depart from upstream's; absent when they do not.
